caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a simple, rustic design. The chair features a slightly curved, horizontal top backrest slat and a straight middle slat, both rendered in a medium brown color. Four vertical legs support the structure, each leg cylindrical with turned, decorative segments and hints of yellowish accents at the joints. The seat is woven in a diagonal criss-cross pattern, illustrated in a lighter brown or tan color, adding a textured look to the central portion of the chair. There are multiple horizontal support bars connecting the legs for stability. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color, and the chair is centered on the page with no other objects visible.
title: Hitchcock Chair
